website.first: Build a single-page index.html for an independent photography studio. Include a clear booking entry point, a portfolio filter, keyboard-accessible previews with Escape dismissal, service information, and a validated booking draft. Use warm paper, dark ink, and one teal accent. Without a backend, create copyable booking details. Verify at 390px and 1280px, including keyboard order and form errors.
website.second: Build an offline exhibition guide in index.html. Organize title, dates and venue, provide a date-based schedule, curator notes, accessible visit information, and a print view. Use sourced local media or SVG placeholders. Verify schedule switching, anchor navigation, reading order, and print layout.
website.third: Build a single-file, offline arts festival guide as index.html. The hero shows the event name, dates, venue and key art; filters by date and programme type; artist/curator cards, venue details and accessibility information. Include print styles, an empty-filter state and keyboard-operable filters. Use editorial typography, a black-and-white palette with one accent colour, and preserve reading order on mobile. Test 390px and 1280px for filtering, anchors, print and keyboard use.

app.first: Build a local reading tracker in index.html. Add, edit and delete books, record progress, ratings and notes, and filter by status and tags. Show a yearly goal and monthly trend. Support CSV import/export and persistence after reload. Handle empty states, malformed rows and duplicates. Verify editing, reload and a CSV round trip.
app.second: Build a local weekly spending tracker in index.html. Let users add, edit and delete amounts, dates and categories. Show remaining budget and category totals. Persist locally and support JSON import/export. Verify invalid amounts, week boundaries, reload, and malformed imports. Label example data.
app.third: Create a local, single-file habit tracker as index.html using HTML, CSS and JavaScript. Add, edit and archive habits with daily check-ins persisted in localStorage; show current streaks, weekly completion and a monthly heatmap, plus empty states, reset-week and JSON export. Optimise for one-handed mobile use while keeping a clear desktop hierarchy. Test refresh recovery, week boundaries, delete/undo and corrupt-data handling.

game.first: Build an offline 2D paper-plane game in index.html. Use keyboard and touch controls to fly through rings and avoid obstacles within 45 seconds. Implement start, pause, results and restart; pause on focus loss. Separate simulation from rendering, use a fixed step and expose a concise read-only game state. Verify scoring, collisions, timeouts, restart and touch.
game.second: Build a locally playable box-pushing puzzle in index.html with three solvable stages. Support arrows and touch, undo, reset, stage selection and a win state. Keep rule state separate from rendering and use no network. Play every stage to completion and verify legal pushes, wall collisions, undo and victory.
game.third: Build a local 2D neon flight game as a single index.html using Canvas and a fixed timestep. Use arrow keys or touch to fly through rings and avoid obstacles; include start, pause, auto-pause on blur, results and restart. Show score, speed, high score and persist the high score locally. Use a deep-space gradient with cyan and violet glow, plus a reduced-motion fallback. Test collisions, pause, blur, results, restart and multiple screen sizes.

home.showcaseAppPrompt: Please build a reading tracker for me. Let me add books and record reading progress, ratings, and notes, set a yearly reading goal (such as 50 books), and see how much I have finished. Show a dashboard with a yearly progress bar, reading volume by genre, a monthly reading trend, and a few plain-language insights, for example "You have read 23 books this year, 3 ahead of the yearly goal, and novels make up 58% of your reading." Support CSV import and export. Store the data in the browser.
home.showcaseImagePrompt: An athlete sprints at full effort down a rainy night street, in a dynamic side medium shot that clearly shows the head, ear, upper body, and running posture. A pair of pearl-white wireless sport earbuds sits naturally on the ear, with a translucent silicone wing fitted to the ear; the product is clearly visible at a true-to-life size. The athlete's foot strikes standing water and throws up a splash, and the wet pavement reflects electric lime and cool cyan neon. Deep indigo night, cold cinematic light, a few lime-colored motes of dust, with the energy of a premium sports-technology advertisement.
